notes.title: Free to Play Now Available!
notes.notes:
Metagalactic Blitz is now free to play!

As previously mentioned, if you bought the game before the switch to free to play, you will have access to all of the characters currently in the game.

For anyone trying out the game for the first time, welcome! You will have access to the first 4 characters for free, and the rest can be bought individually. There is a "Try" button so that you can test out the mechanics against an AI player before you buy. Leave us feedback here on the forums, or you can find us over on the MGB [url=https://discord.gg/jAaAGgW]Discord[/url]. Enjoy the game!

notes.notes: Our version of free to play is ready, but there is a delay in making sure everyone owning the paid version is granted all the characters, so we will be waiting to release until that process goes through. We should be ready to go next week.

notes.title: Free to Play coming April 4th
notes.notes:
[b]Quick update, we've hashed out the details and will be releasing the free to play version on April 4th, next Thursday![/b]

Also, the game is on sale from now until we go free to play. If you are planning on buying all the characters, now is the time! It will be cheaper to grab the original game on sale than it will be to buy all the individual characters once we go free to play.

notes.title: Free to Play plans
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! Today we are announcing our plans to switch Metagalactic Blitz to a free to play model, and we are doing this specifically to get people into the online queue. Here are the details:

[h1]What's for sale?[/h1]
Initially, characters will be the only purchasable item. We will be making Polly, Lt. Justice, Veronica, Max, and Zandra individually available to buy. The rest of the content in the game will be free.

[h1]What if I bought the game already?[/h1]
We will be granting these 5 characters to everyone who buys the game before we go free to play. So you will still own all the content you bought.

[h1]What will you put up for sale in the future?[/h1]
Nothing is for certain yet, but we have talked about adding new characters in the future, along with some cosmetic items.

[b]Other Comments[/b]
Our intention here is to open up the game to a larger playerbase so we can all get more out of the online system, and make sure that current owners feel that the change was fair.

Thoughts? Comments? What do you think?

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Physics Engine Rework
[list]
[*]Turns out the physics engine had some non-deterministic edge cases, causing desyncs on some machines. So for this patch, I rewrote most of the game's physics code. You shouldn't notice much difference in gameplay.
[*]Added many physics optimizations, to compensate for some slower performance after the rewrite. As a result, you will actually see an increase in performance from the last patch.
[*]Reworked Zomborg's shotgun physics for better performance. It is now a single hitbox that instantly deals damage the frame you use it. It will penetrate targets, and simulates a number of bolts hit. The closer the target is to Zomborg, and the closer to the center of the blast they are, the higher the number of hits. As a result, it is no longer completely useless at mid-range, and the damage falls off more smoothly over the hitbox's range.
[*]Reworked the code that manages Cyber City's laser push mode. This fixes a number of bugs, and increases its performance. (This also fixes the bug with no-centerline matches in this mode).
[*]Increased the stun length of Zandra's whirlwind hits from 100ms to 200ms. This will prevent characters from acting while caught in it and cancelling her ability.
[*]Prevented debuffs like max's poison from damaging Veronica's turret health before damaging the shields.
[*]Since this work has all been on the coding side, we had some art bandwidth to create a new skin for Zomborg:
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/fe494c96f49318d4a6772a368d2371497fe3af18.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.7
notes.notes:
Patch v0.7 is now live, which will be the last patch before the transition to full release on 11/16. In this patch we added the new map, Treetop Terrace!

This map spawns special throwable crystals along with the normal dodgeballs, each having a unique effect. Here's a quick match between devs showcasing the new map:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kotKDPdwW38

[h1]The 5 Types of Crystals[/h1]

[b]Ice[/b]
Significantly slows your speed.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/c9f93c0d72c5ff5e041375adaaf7686c5451fd77.gif[/img]

[b]Confusion[/b]
Reverses your movement and aiming controls.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/0f500141054051b32274ad5b1952c8b78f089583.gif[/img]

[b]Lightning[/b]
Stuns for a medium amount of time.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/009ffe68e3f554d823ff3ffaa99784e4cb62793a.gif[/img]

[b]Concussion[/b]
Causes a heavy-hitting explosion.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/e773fbf0b91bac666ddd6fcedd40f96b54d1d5b9.gif[/img]

[b]Bramble[/b]
Creates a patch of thorny vines on the floor.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/6da2c163852bc88bcae984fa96aa2bd7a60d7b77.gif[/img]


One crystal spawns at a time, the next being tossed out after the current one is thrown. Matches on this map revolve around competition for the crystals.

The crystals in Treetop Terrace are thrown out by the rocky natives, who love a good dodgeball match!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/d8cc8d514e47d017a2c9b4cfb5143fa9f812fd88.gif[/img]



That sums up our new map, I hope you guys have fun with it! We are going to be working on some polish and marketing next, and the transition from early access to full release will happen on 11/16!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/a5f066e75c0cc14006bb98a39a81d5aec94afc90.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.4 - Optimization
notes.notes:
Optimization patch just went live! Not a very content-heavy patch, but I'm sure some will appreciate this:

-assets are now being preloaded, and more projectiles like balls are being recycled in memory, so the game should run noticeably smoother on older machines now.
-balls are now seen traveling when stolen by max, and added a little animation when you pick up a ball:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/fd75add4ff94b16755a9883cf4e1dc60c3ad7235.gif[/img]



As a side note, we've met our [url=http://www.pixelvex.com/development]dev timeline [/url] for our first few patches, but it looks like our next map won't be polished/ready for release by next week, so that date will be pushed back until we are really happy with the map. I also swapped the dates for updates v0.6 and v0.7, since we realized that would make much more sense. Get excited for the content coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 0.3 - Juggerbot mode!
notes.notes:
Patch daaaaay!

Major Changes:
[list]
[*]implemented a [b]local multiplayer[/b] game mode: Juggerbot mode! Best played as a 4 player FFA timed battle. The player that currently holds the Juggerbot gains ridiculous strength! Team up to kill him!

Bug Fixes:

[*]fixed issue with submenus being unselected after alt tabbing out
[*]made music stop immediately when you alt+f4
[*]tutorial text fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Plan - Tentative Full Release Date of 11/16
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

Peter and I went through our plans, organized our features, and picked out tentative release dates for our patches. We have a tidy view of them on the website: http:www.pixelvex.com/development

They are ALL subject to change, so don't expect these dates to be exact. Since this is an effort done in our free time, we thought making public development plans with tentative deadlines would be the best way to keep ourselves on track, and keep you in the loop.

Also, these are only the bigger patches that add content. We will be patching bugs and balance issues ASAP as they are discovered in between these patches. Also also wik, the content of the patches is malleable. It can be changed if it turns out everyone hates something in particular, or feels the game is incomplete without a certain feature.
